text:
sam: Heads-up — main CI is red on integration-ubuntu:py39. Failure after image build step in `integration/runner`. Buildkite: https://ci.example.com/pipelines/redwood/main/1234. Can someone retrigger just the failing job without rebuilding the base image? Want to avoid the 20m image build.

jess: You can use the ci-bot rerun helper to skip image builds. Example:```@ci-bot rerun --job integration-ubuntu:py39 --skip-image-build```That will resubmit the job axis only.

matt: If the failure is a flaky test, prefer single-job rerun. If the problem is the image (e.g., docker push failed), then do a rebuild-only:```@ci-bot rebuild-images --pipeline main --image base:latest```Use rebuild-only sparingly.

lina: I just triggered the no-image rerun for you, sam. ci-bot should post the new job id shortly. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: retriggered job integration-ubuntu:py39 -> build #12345 (triggered by lina). Logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/12345

sam: Thanks! If this fails again, next step is a targeted bisect to find the commit. Quick bisect command:```@ci-bot bisect --job integration-ubuntu:py39 --range HEAD~30..HEAD```That runs binary search over commits and will stop when it finds the bad commit.

jess: Note — bisect can consume a lot of CI minutes. Before bisecting, try reproducing locally with the same image and `TEST_FILTER` to narrow to suspected tests:```TEST_FILTER=TestFoo pytest tests/integration/test_foo.py -k something```

matt: Also check artifacts for flaky traces: look at `artifacts/system-info.txt` and `artifacts/test-output.xml` on the failed build — often shows environment hiccups.

sam: Got it. Lina, keep an eye on #12345 and ping if it flakes again. If we need to bisect I'll ask infra to bump parallelism so it finishes faster.

lina: Will do. If anyone else sees related failures on other axes, add them here so we can decide full rebuild vs targeted rerun.

jess: FYI: web UI quick path — open the build, click the failed job -> "Restart" dropdown -> "Restart without rebuilding images" (Buildkite: Restart job -> Restart job without rebuilding).

matt: TL;DR: use `--skip-image-build` for quick reruns, `rebuild-images` for image problems, and `bisect` only after reproducing locally or when multiple reruns keep failing.
